rationale: No supported optimization applies to this workflow. The workflow already caches the validator image via actions/cache/restore (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE partially applied), so adding another dependency cache is not a minimal unsupported change. It is a single-job reusable workflow with no matrix strategy, so P-LIT-FAIL-FAST does not apply. It already declares timeout-minutes: 60, and the repository CI history shows no completed runs and no measured baseline, so there is no representative successful-duration history to justify reducing or deriving a custom timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT preconditions unmet). It is not scheduled, so schedule-suppression patterns do not apply. It uses Nix rather than Bazel, so Bazel parallelism/incremental-cache patterns do not apply. The available experiment evidence is either synthetic (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST, P-LIT-UNUSED-DEP-SKIP, P-LIT-ENV-CACHE) or concerns adding a timeout where none existed (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT), which does not match this workflow. Preserving existing build and test coverage requires no change.
